description: This file defines interfaces and types related to gRPC load balancing, specifically the SubConn interface, which manages individual backend connections, and related constructs such as ProducerBuilder, SubConnState, and Producer.

classes.name: SubConn
classes.description: Interface representing a single connection to a gRPC backend, with methods for managing connection state, addresses, health, and shutdown.

classes.name: ProducerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for constructing a Producer associated with a SubConn.

classes.name: SubConnState
classes.description: Struct describing the current state of a SubConn, including connectivity status, errors, and connected address.

classes.name: Producer
classes.description: Type representing a shared producer object associated with a SubConn.

methods.name: UpdateAddresses
methods.description: Updates the list of addresses for the SubConn.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection attempt for the SubConn.

methods.name: GetOrBuildProducer
methods.description: Returns an existing Producer or creates a new one for the SubConn.

methods.name: RegisterHealthListener
methods.description: Registers a health status listener for the SubConn.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs a new Producer for the SubConn.
